observations: For Robin: V2 grading_delta 2 (USB mouth X in [-1.8, -0.8]) conflicts with L2.1.6 on this board. The catalogue grid for a 90 x 45 board starts at X 5.63; a mouth in [-1.8, -0.8] puts the first Pico header pin at X 0.87-1.87, at least 3.76 mm from any grid hole (limit 0.15). The design chose pin 1 on grid column 0 (residual 0.00), which is what forces the mouth to 2.96. Graded as written.

The jack bodies of connector_1_1 (X 21-27) and connector_1_2 (X 42-48) touch the Pico PCB's -Y edge at Y 12.0 with zero gap (Z 2.5-3.5). R7 passes (0 mm3), but there is no assembly tolerance; a real PJ-320A (drawing 6.1 wide) would likely collide. Visible in ghost_iso.png and ghost_top.png.
The corner bosses stand fully outside the wall corners (OD 6.6 centred 0.21 mm inside the outer corner), so the plan outline has four round ears; the lid pads copy them, so the outline match holds.
Front/back/left/right renders use an elevated camera, so the lid top appears above the walls; this is a render choice, not a geometry defect.
